name: APR Advanced Calculator
meta_title: Advanced APR Calculator with Odd First Period and Fees
meta_description: Calculate the APR of a loan with fees, points, prepaid interest, an odd first period and weekly to annual payments, using the Regulation Z method.
subtitle: Work out the annual percentage rate of a loan with fees, points, a first payment that comes early or late, and any payment frequency from weekly to yearly.

card.fields_html:
Enter the loan terms

$
%

Interest accrues at the note rate divided by the number of payments a year.

If the gap between the two dates is longer or shorter than one payment period, the first period is "odd" and the APR accounts for it.

Charged at the note rate on a 365-day year. Mortgages usually collect it at closing; most other loans adjust the first payment.

Finance charges
$

Origination, underwriting, processing and similar fees paid at closing or withheld from the loan proceeds.

points
$

One point is 1% of the loan amount. Fees added to the loan are borrowed, so interest is charged on them too.

The APR follows the actuarial method in Regulation Z, Appendix J: the yearly rate at which the payments, on their actual schedule, repay exactly the amount financed. Finance charge is the total of payments minus the amount financed.
